title: CampCraft Modpack
description: This is a list of mods, including fabulous optimized, combined with other mods, specifically for content creation. It just has the essentials for it to be optimized on your system and to have flexibility.
body:
**What is CampCraft?**


CampCraft is a Minecraft survival server where storytelling meets adventure! Players unite to explore, build, and battle against a spreading corruption. Our community thrives on creativity, voice chat, and player-driven events.

This can be used by anyone, but it's more specifically for our campers!

[Support Us!](https://ko-fi.com/campcraft)

[CampCraft YT](https://www.youtube.com/@CampCraft-)
